rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the central design question: the known balanced batch enters as a fixed effect in ~ batch + condition with condition last, and count-level correction (ComBat-seq or any pre-scaling) is explicitly forbidden before the test, with the reason stated. QC precedes the model on a blind VST with PCA, sample-distance heatmap and library sizes all annotated by both condition and batch, plus a stated no-drop/flag policy and the condition-by-batch cross-tab. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by the smallest group size; size factors and TMM are estimated inside the models; the reference level is set with relevel and the contrast is written as treated over control; BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage by coefficient name for reporting only, p-value histogram inspected, and outlier-flag NAs separated from filtering NAs. Enrichment is not strictly demanded by the question but is handled correctly when run: full ranked tested list, Wald statistic with justification, named human collections and versions, 15-500 window applied post-intersection, seed recorded, within-collection BH, collapsing, and an explicit rule not to run ORA on a short list. The final report names methods, versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, DESeq2/edgeR intersection, and honest limitations on power and untestable batch-by-condition interaction.
